svg.title: VRC: one layout, several floors
svg.desc: Side elevation: a VRC platform carries an AGV and its tray from a node on floor F1 to a node on floor F2; VrcTransition simulates idle -> moving -> idle and moves entities at the source node.

g.text: Side elevation (not a plan view). A vertical reciprocating conveyor carries an AGV and its tray between floor-specific nodes. This is general code-supported behaviour;

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: the Pecos YAML has no VRC, so it is not placed on the Pecos map.
